description: Rate-driven buffer activity validation: RouterInputPort WriteRate/ReadRate/FlitToggleRate replacing hardcoded write-enable-always-asserted and uniform-random-flit-data assumptions.

sweep_config.note: N=64 (bufs_per_vc), B=128 (flit_width), single VC (VC count not specified by task; chosen for isolation of WriteRate/ReadRate effects).

constraints_honored.area_reported_as: Area->Active only, never summed with Metal1Wire
constraints_honored.energy_semantics: C*Vdd^2 per 0->1 transition, no 1/2 factor applied (DSENT's own convention, unmodified)

1_area_leakage_bit_identical.description: Area->Active and NddPower->Leakage must be bit-identical to Phase 4 baseline at every sweep point / rate setting.

2_writerate_sweep_e_write.description: Sweep WriteRate at fixed N=64,B=128 (ReadRate=1.0, FlitToggleRate=0.5 held fixed). e_write must fall monotonically as WriteRate falls.

3_readrate_sweep_e_read_and_independence.description: Sweep ReadRate at fixed N=64,B=128 (WriteRate=1.0, FlitToggleRate=0.5 held fixed). e_read must fall monotonically as ReadRate falls; e_write must not move under a ReadRate-only sweep, and vice versa (checked against item 2's e_read column).

4_flittogglerate_sweep_e_write_linear_e_.description: Sweep FlitToggleRate at fixed N=64,B=128 (WriteRate=ReadRate=1.0 held fixed). e_write must scale roughly linearly with it; e_read must not move at all.

5_all_zero_rates_idle_nonzero.description: WriteRate=ReadRate=FlitToggleRate=0 -> e_idle must be non-zero (clock tree / flop clock pins still switch every cycle regardless of traffic).

6_delta_at_all_rates_1p0_vs_phase4_basel.description: Delta at WriteRate=ReadRate=1.0, FlitToggleRate=0.5 (Phase 5 defaults) vs stored Phase 4 baseline (same N=64,B=128 config, pre-Phase-5 code). Attributed to change (a): Push/WE's TransitionInfo now models 'toggles every cycle' (P(1)=0.5) instead of the old 'held high, never toggling' (P(1)=1.0) -- this is an intentional, documented behavior change, not a regression.
6_delta_at_all_rates_1p0_vs_phase4_basel.root_cause_note: The delta is almost entirely (~98.9%) in e_write_dff_array, not in a standalone 'WE wire' term -- Push/WE gates DFFRAM's per-row write clock (NAND2_CKGate1_i), so changing WE's own P(1) from 1.0 to 0.5 changes the gated clock's computed transition profile seen by every row's DFFQ, which DFFRAM attributes to its DFFD/DFFQ/CK sub-events (summed into e_write_dff_array). e_write_clockgate exactly halves (P(1) 1.0->0.5), consistent with this. FlitIn's own TransitionInfo is numerically unchanged at the new FlitToggleRate=0.5 default (0.25,0.25,0.25 either way), so none of this delta comes from flit data activity.

prerequisite_fix.issue: Stale rip->getSubInstance("RDAddr_DFF"+j) references from before Phase 2's FIFOControl rework; RouterInputPort no longer has that sub-instance (only "RAM" and "FIFO0"/"FIFO1"/...). Running the tool as found threw 'Instance not exists (RDAddr_DFF0)' immediately -- confirmed empirically before any Phase 5 edits.
prerequisite_fix.fix: Repointed the read-pointer-register area/leakage/energy breakdown to FIFO0's own RDIdx_DFF0..idx_bits-1 (idx_bits, not addr_bits -- the VC-select bits above the per-VC slice have no real flops). Added --write-rate/--read-rate/--flit-toggle-rate CLI flags (defaults 1.0/1.0/0.5, matching RouterInputPort's own parameter defaults) so real sweeps could be run for this validation.

code_changes_summary.RouterInputPort.cc/.h: Added WriteRate (default 1.0), ReadRate (default 1.0), FlitToggleRate (default 0.5) parameters with [0,1] ASSERTs. FlitIn on WriteBuffer now derived from FlitToggleRate (numerically identical to the old (0.25,0.25,0.25) at the new default). Push on WriteBuffer and Pop on ReadBuffer now derived from WriteRate/ReadRate respectively, mirroring OutputVCState's Grant/CreditIn-scaled-by-Utilization pattern exactly -- NOT bit-identical to the old hardcoded (0,0,1) even at rate=1.0, by design (see item 6). WriteRate/ReadRate are also passed down to each FIFOControl instance.
code_changes_summary.FIFOControl.cc/.h: Added WriteRate/ReadRate parameters (default 1.0 each, set by RouterInputPort). WRIdx_DFF/RDIdx_DFF's counter-aware D-formula p = 1/2^(i+1) is now p = WriteRate/2^(i+1) (resp. ReadRate) -- numerically identical to the old formula at the new default of 1.0.
code_changes_summary.OutputVCState.cc/.h: Documentation-only cross-reference comments ('Phase 5 unification note') -- no numeric or structural change. True single-source value sharing between RouterInputPort's WriteRate/ReadRate and OutputVCState's Utilization would require editing Router.cc, which is out of this phase's file scope.
